content: Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of dexamethasone by inhibiting the metabolism mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Conversely, dexamethasone decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant through the same enzymatic pathway. Caution and monitoring are advised when these drugs are co-administered. Dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA), a herbal supplement, increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of diazepam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Both dichlorphenamide and aprepitant decrease serum potassium levels. Caution and monitoring are necessary to avoid hypokalemia. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Adverse effects such as nausea, irregular uterine bleeding, breast tenderness, and headache should be monitored. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of diltiazem by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of doxorubicin and liposomal doxorubicin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Dronedarone increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Duvelisib increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Efavirenz decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer, and co-administration with CYP3A substrates may necessitate dose adjustments. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of eletriptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the plasma levels of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that have a high risk of serious or life-threatening events due to elevated plasma concentrations. Encorafenib both inhibits and induces CYP3A4 at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Co-administration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may increase toxicity or reduce efficacy. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of erlotinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Eslcarbazepine acetate decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of estradiol, conjugated estrogens, esterified estrogens, and estropipate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Estrogens are CYP3A4 substrates, and their efficacy in hormone replacement therapy may be reduced. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of etonogestrel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of etoposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while etravirine decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fedratinib increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Dose adjustments of CYP3A4 substrates may be necessary. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of felodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of fesoterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of finerenone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Serum potassium should be monitored during initiation and dosage adjustments of finerenone or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Fluconazole increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of fludrocortisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while fludrocortisone decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of fosamprenavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fosphenytoin decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of gepirone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. The gepirone dose should be reduced by 50% when co-administered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Grapefruit increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Griseofulvin decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of guanfacine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors significantly increase guanfacine plasma concentrations. For extended-release guanfacine, the dosage should be halved when co-administered with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of hydrocortisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while hydrocortisone decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant decreases the effects of ifosfamide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Monitor for ifosfamide neurotoxicity (e.g., hallucinations, somnolence, confusion, delirium) and decreased efficacy when combined with fosaprepitant. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of iloperidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while iloperidone increases the plasma levels of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Iloperidone is a time-dependent CYP3A inhibitor and may increase plasma levels of drugs predominantly eliminated by CYP3A4. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of imipramine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of indinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while indinavir increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of irinotecan and liposomal irinotecan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant decreases the plasma levels or effects of isavuconazonium sulfate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Isoniazid increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Istradefylline increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Istradefylline 40 mg/day increased peak levels and AUC of CYP3A4 substrates in clinical trials, but this effect was not observed with 20 mg/day. Dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates should be considered. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of ivosidenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Co-administration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase ivosidenib plasma concentrations, raising the risk of QTc prolongation. Monitor for QTc interval prolongation. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of ixabepilone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of lapatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Larotrectinib increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of lefamulin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Monitor for adverse effects if lefamulin is co-administered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. Lenacapavir increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Lenacapavir, a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, may increase CYP3A4 substrates initiated within 9 months after the last subcutaneous dose of lenacapavir, potentially increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Letermovir increases the plasma levels of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of levamlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Co-administration with moderate and strong CYP3A inhibitors increases systemic exposure to amlodipine and may require dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema when amlodipine is co-administered with CYP3A inhibitors to determine the need for dose adjustment. Aprepitant decreases the plasma levels or effects of levonorgestrel/ethinyl estradiol/ferrous bisglycinate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. The efficacy of hormonal contraceptives may be reduced. Use an alternative or backup method of contraception when enzyme inducers are used with combined hormonal contraceptives (CHCs), and continue backup contraception for 28 days after discontinuing the enzyme inducer to ensure contraceptive reliability. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of linagliptin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended when linagliptin is to be administered with a CYP3A4 inducer. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of lopinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while lopinavir increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of loratadine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Lorlatinib decreases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of lumateperone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Reduce the lumateperone dose to 21 mg/day if co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of lumefantrine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels of lurasidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. The manufacturer recommends decreasing the starting dose of lurasidone to 20 mg/day and the maximum daily dose to 80 mg when co-administered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Concurrent use may increase the risk of lurasidone-related adverse reactions. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of maraviroc by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Marijuana increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of mavacamten by inhibiting both CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Initiation of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may require a decreased mavacamten dose. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of mavorixafor by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are required. Monitor for mavorixafor adverse effects if co-administered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. Mavorixafor increases the plasma levels or effects of aprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Monitor for adverse effects of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates if co-administered with mavorixafor, a weak CYP3A4 inhibitor. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of mefloquine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of mestranol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Aprepitant increases the plasma levels or effects of methadone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended.
